title: Cosmic Chicken Shit
description: A surreal painting depicts a giant twisted chicken emerging from a cracked pot, its neck formed from gnarled vines. The chicken has a massive bloodshot human eyeball for a head, an open screaming beak with red liquid dripping, and a bright red comb, set against a dark cosmic sky with a cracked planet, shooting stars, and floating portals.
prompt: Surreal cosmic horror scene of a giant chicken emerging from a cracked ceramic pot, its long neck made of twisted brown vines and roots. The chicken has a massive realistic bloodshot human eyeball for a head with a colorful iris, an open screaming yellow beak dripping red liquid, and a bright red comb. Purple octopus tentacles emerge from the ground near the base along with pink and orange flowers, a wooden sign reads 'CHICKEN SHIT'. Background is a dark starry sky with swirling clouds, a cracked planet with an orange core, shooting stars, and glowing circular portals in the sky.
